name: connection-approved-unverified-replaced-api
subject: A connection to your mail was approved

blocks.text: A connection to your mail was approved on your Permaily account. The app below can read the mail it allows until it ends. It replaces the connection that app had before.

facts.label: Reads
facts.value: Sender and date, subject, body text, attachments

blocks.text: You can see what it reads, and revoke it, in Connections at app.permaily.com.
If this wasn't you, sign in at app.permaily.com, revoke it in Connections, sign out the devices you don't know, and write to support@permaily.com.
